description: Pages for therapist sites built from sanitised HTML and a fixed set of components, with version history, style packs and bundled fonts.
changelog:
0.11.0

  • New: Tell us. Anyone who can edit pages can tell you what they would like changed, from the front of their own site. Notes are kept on the site as text and deleted after the time you choose (12 months unless changed). Off until switched on in the Site tab.
  • New: an administrator sees every note, sets a status, adds private ideas and copies the new notes as markdown. Commands: wp twd-sk snags, snag-status and snags-setting.
  • New: an optional email that says a note has arrived and never contains it.
  • New: signed-in editors see a small version label in the bottom left corner.
  • Changed: Edit text is now called Visual editor.
  • Safe mode switches Tell us off.

0.10.2

  • Changed: the Edit text toolbar is a compact card at the bottom left, clear of other plugins' buttons.
  • New: Edit text, Save changes and Cancel in the WordPress admin bar.

0.10.1

  • New: Add a picture boxes in Edit text where the AI left a picture marker.
  • New: Upload from this computer, beside Choose from the media library.
  • New: change a picture's description on its own.

0.10.0

  • New: Edit text. Change words, links and pictures right on the page; only the changed pieces are saved, as a new version.
  • New: one box in Edit with AI. Write a list of changes, untick from a checklist, preview, then apply as one version.
  • New sections: glow boxes in the site's colours and a testimonial slider. Both respect reduced motion.
  • The section picker, extra facts box and Add a section panel are replaced by the one box.

0.9.3

  • New: Choose the brief file on the setup page, and facts can be a list of short lines.
  • Fixed: a brief that cannot be read says where, and Build waits until it is fixed.
  • Fixed: building again updates the menu and header button the setup made, moves the about link and lists pages no longer planned.
  • The logo slot says it is the header and footer logo and shows the whole logo.

0.9.2

  • Fixed: long site briefs and pages no longer fail with "The AI ran out of room". Long pages are written a few sections at a time, and a part that is still too long is split and tried again.
  • Fixed: a site brief pasted into the notes box is checked directly, with no AI call.
  • Long notes are kept as the facts word for word.
  • Ask the AI says to choose fewer sections when a change is too big for one go.

0.9.1

  • On the Hello theme Site Kit places the header and footer itself, so Elementor Pro is not needed. A Skip to content link comes first.
  • Site tab, Header and footer: choose who places them. An Elementor Pro template still takes over where it applies.
  • In safe mode, on another theme or on Canvas pages, Site Kit stands aside and Hello's own header and footer show.
  • The launch check, site report and build report say who places them.

0.9.0

  • New: the launch check, with publishing of the pages that are ready (setup page Launch step, Site tab, site report, wp twd-sk launch-check).

0.8.4

  • New: starting points per kind of site on the setup page (counselling, coaching, mobile hire, trades, studio or classes), and wp twd-sk build --set.

0.8.3

  • New: keep in view, a crop position for each picture, set in the media library or on the setup page.

0.8.2

  • New: colours from the logo (Site tab, setup page, wp twd-sk brand), every colour checked so text stays easy to read.

0.8.1

  • New: an Enquiry form section, emailed to the site address, with spam protection and limits. Nothing about a message is stored on the site.

0.8.0

  • New sections: Pictures, Logos strip, Prices, Opening hours, Areas covered.

0.7.3

  • New: Add a section in the Edit with AI pop-up: where, which kind and layout, written by AI from the facts when a key is set, previewed before saving.

0.7.2

  • New: the Pages step in the setup page: the list of pages and the sections on each, changed before anything is built.
  • New: a site brief's pages can list their own sections.

0.7.1

  • New: the setup page (Settings, Set up site), with a Set this site up link on a fresh site's front page for administrators: site type, style, brief or plain notes, pictures, then a step-by-step build of every page as a draft.
  • New: wp twd-sk build.
  • The site report shows the setup state and the build log.

0.7.0

  • New: therapy or business mode. One switch for administrators (Site tab, Site type; or wp twd-sk mode business; or mode in a site brief) that changes the wording the editor and the AI use, the facts outline, the page types, the interview prompt and the search engine details. Therapy stays the default and its wording is unchanged. Switching never rewrites a page.

0.6.2

  • New: wp twd-sk doctor and a Site report in the Site tab, a safe-to-paste report of the site's state.

0.6.1

  • New: the site brief, one file to build or update a whole site (check first, then apply).
  • New: interview prompt for gathering the information in a Claude conversation.

0.6.0

  • A simpler Edit with AI pop-up: detail is tucked into fold-outs.

0.5.3

  • New: Ask the AI for header, footer and style suggestions in the Site tab (needs an AI key in the Articles plugin). Suggestions fill the boxes and are never saved by themselves.

0.5.2

  • New: Practice facts master document (administrators only) in the Site tab.
  • New: draft About, Contact, Home, service or topic and Q and A pages from the facts, saved as drafts.

0.5.1

  • Fixed: a missing Site name no longer makes the header ignore your menu. The site title is used instead.

0.5.0

  • New: Ask the AI in the Edit this page tab, by section or for the whole page, with a preview before saving (needs an AI key set in the Articles plugin).
  • New: testimonials and the safety notice keep their words unless you say otherwise.
  • Changed: copy and paste is now under Use an external AI instead.

0.4.1

  • New: Edit header and Edit footer buttons appear on the page after you click Edit with AI (administrators only).
  • New: closing the pop-up with unsaved changes asks first.

0.4.0

  • New: Site tab (style pack, colours, fonts, corners, live preview, reset).
  • New: site details, header and footer with four layouts each, mobile menu, Elementor Theme Builder templates.
  • New: Home, About and Contact starter pages and a setup command.
  • New: Search tab, plain-text copy of pages for search, picture sizes and lazy loading, structured data.
  • New: safe mode switches the new features off.

0.3.1

  • New: TWD Kit Page template, Pages tab (new draft pages, publish and unpublish with confirmation, switch to the kit template).
  • Publishing is blocked while must-fix example text remains (explicit override); example wording is a check-only warning.
  • Prompt and leftover check fixes.

0.3.0

  • New: Edit with AI on the front end for signed-in editors (copy the prompt, paste the result, preview on the real page, apply, undo and restore).
  • New: secure editor routes with nonce, permission checks, size and rate limits.

0.2.6

  • New: wp twd-sk check lists leftover example text, and saving warns about it.
  • Improved client AI prompt rules.

0.2.5

  • New: wp twd-sk prompt prints the client AI prompt for a page.
  • Loose content directly in a page gets a safe width and side padding.
  • [PLACEHOLDER] text is kept so missing details stay visible.

0.2.4

  • The resources component styles the articles plugin grid from the active pack. No effect when that plugin is absent.

0.2.3

  • Minimum text sizes: body 16px, eyebrows and small text 14px.
  • Text on bands and buttons reaches 4.5:1 contrast in both packs.

0.2.2

  • Fix: two-column layouts (image and text, text with aside) fill the full container width.
  • The narrow text layout is one centred column.

0.2.1

  • New: the plugin can now update itself from the Plugins screen. It checks for a newer version every 12 hours, and a "Check for updates" link on the plugin row checks straight away.
  • Every update is checked against a checksum before it is installed. If the file does not match, nothing is installed.

0.2.0

  • The one-h1 rule and theme title hiding, eleven components with variants, component styles, style packs (sage and grove), bundled fonts, and the component gallery.

0.1.0

  • First release: page store with version history, the sanitiser, the [twd_page] shortcode and WP-CLI commands.
